trust_decision.summary: Admin-supplied dynamic cache settings (status/type/host/port/username/password) are concatenated into double-quoted PHP string literals of configurations/ossn.config.dcache.php, which is include()d at every boot; the only defence is input()'s htmlspecialchars + quote/backslash escaping, which does not neutralise $ and {} interpolation inside double quotes.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'Cache Settings dynamic.php'; the PHP template building the config file is the obvious sink in that one file.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST action admin/dynamic/cache (registered for logged-in admins, libraries/ossn.lib.admin.php:20,41)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The installer route (O8) is a different file, only reachable before installation, and its inputs come from the person installing the site, so a solver can argue it is not part of 'cache settings' and the actor is already trusted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Saved settings round-trip: the admin form re-reads $Ossn->dynamic_cache_settings and echoes host/port/username/password back as field values and into the JS connection test; status 'disabled' must still write the file; passwords/usernames containing $, {, quotes or backslashes must stay valid for Redis auth / Memcached SASL. A fix that rejects or strips such characters, or that stops writing the file when disabled, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: all six fields (status, cache_server_type, host, port, username, password) via var_export of an array cast to string (fix.diff:14-23)
string values only; input() html-escapes arrays at libraries/ossn.lib.input.php:113-117 and the fix casts each value with (string)

O7_producer.where: system/start.php:34 includes configurations/ossn.config.dcache.php; libraries/ossn.lib.cache.php:286-289 reads the result

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Installer writes raw $_POST url/datadir/dbuser/dbpwd/dbname into single-quoted PHP literals of ossn.config.site.php / ossn.config.db.php via str_replace, with no escaping; these files are include()d at boot.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Pre-install only (installation/index.php:23 blocks it once INSTALLED exists), different file and feature from cache settings, and the installer operator is the site owner.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second admin settings action (e.g. SMTP or CDN settings) persisting to configurations/*.php through the same string-template idiom.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already stores boot-time config as generated PHP (system/start.php:32-34) and the installer uses the same template style (installation/classes/OssnInstall.php:392-412).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A CLI or upgrade helper that regenerates ossn.config.dcache.php from stored settings, a save/reload producer the action-level fix never calls.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI admin command hook exists (libraries/ossn.lib.admin.php:58) and upgrades write files under the tree (upgrade/upgrade.php:13).

O9_family: code injection into generated PHP configuration (CWE-94 via string-interpolated template)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8 + web server; no composer.json or test harness in tree
services: Redis or Memcached only for status=enabled path
O10_build.project_tests: none found (no tests/, phpunit.xml or composer.json at pinned commit)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add more quote/backslash escaping to the values (already done by input()), leaving $/{} interpolation in double-quoted literals open; or strip non-alphanumerics, breaking legitimate passwords.

out_of_scope_notes: installation/classes/OssnInstall.php:302-304 substitutes raw sitename/emails into SQL text (SQL injection in installer), not pursued.
system/plugins/default/forms/admin/dynamic_cache_settings.php:95 echoes stored settings inside JS single-quoted strings, possible XSS sink, not pursued.
themes/goblue/actions/settings.php:39-41 takes the saved logo extension from the client filename, upload concern, not pursued.
unverified: repo size in MB not measured; tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed.

Whether the installer route counts as in-scope for the advisory's property is debatable; it is pre-auth only before install and requires a successful DB connect for db fields (installation/classes/OssnInstall.php:294-299), but url/datadir are not gated by DB connect.
single_site flag withheld only because of the installer O8 route; if that route is judged out of scope, this host is single_site and pattern_fit is injection_only.
